findings.claim: Endpoint-coordinate effects are dominated by shape (second-moment) descriptors rather than centroid translation: shape_yy shows the strongest integrated high-low contrast (z=-0.513, q=1.5e-5, positive_batch_fraction=0.0), with shape_xx (z=-0.495, q=8.1e-4) and shape_zz (z=-0.183, q=0.067) weaker but same-signed. These are signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at the observed endpoint nodes over the complete observed window, not absolute geometric descriptors.

Centroid translation contrasts are largely unsupported: global_centroid_x (z=-0.111, q=0.257) and global_centroid_z (z=-0.061, q=0.481) are null, while global_centroid_y is the only centroid component with a multiplicity-adjusted effect (z=-0.243, q=0.0136, positive_batch_fraction=0.214). This distinguishes selection enrichment of a specific axis from a general absolute geometric descriptor.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed support are non-monotone and unstable: landmark_00_soft_mass has 4 sign changes with first_rate_z=+9.27 and last_rate_z=-10.00, and landmark_00_local_dy has 6 sign changes with first_rate_z=-72.4 and last_rate_z=+5.5. All rows report polynomial_accepted=false and extrapolation_allowed=false, so a constant rule is not supported and only observed-node interpolation is admissible.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control; the observed endpoint contrasts are coordinate rewards, not physical interaction energies or affinity-head derivatives.

hypotheses.direction: favor time-conditioned registered temporal_region recipe over constant rule
hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement in integrated shape contrast, or increased sign conflicts/rate instability, under the time-conditioned rule versus the constant rule.
hypotheses.observable: shape_xx/shape_yy integrated endpoint contrast and continuous_trends sign_changes/rate_z
hypotheses.statement: Time-conditioned regional attention on the shape_yy/shape_xx second-moment contrasts will outperform a constant static rule, because the observed contrast functions change sign and rate across the window while no polynomial fit is accepted.

hypotheses.falsifier: Centroid components showing equal or larger adjusted effects than the shape components.
hypotheses.observable: endpoint_effects high_low_integrated_z and q per feature
hypotheses.statement: Prioritizing the shape second-moment contrasts over centroid translation will yield larger favorable endpoint contrast, since centroid components are mostly null after multiplicity adjustment.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final-affinity outcome data were supplied, so last-record/endpoint credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection versus descendant-survival comparison is unavailable.

No joint_diagnostics, turnover_accounting, increment_effects or lineage_support rows were read in this turn, so within-path change versus cohort-composition and joint-versus-marginal coupling questions remain unassessed.
Contrast curves are coordinate rewards over the observed support only; extrapolation is disallowed and no absolute reward target is established.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
